title: Number Base Converter
h1: Number Base Converter — Bin, Oct, Dec, Hex
seoTitle: Number Base Converter — Binary to Hex
description: Convert integers between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal in the browser. Prefixes like 0x and 0b are accepted. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Paste an integer in binary, octal, decimal or hex and see the same value in the other three bases, including a bit length.
blurb: Convert integers between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal locally.
howItWorks: Enter an integer and pick the base you typed it in.
Press Convert. Optional 0b, 0o and 0x prefixes are stripped when they match the selected base.
Read binary, octal, decimal and hex forms of the same value.
examples: Decimal 255 is binary 11111111, octal 377 and hex FF.
Hex 0x10 in the hexadecimal base is decimal 16.
A digit that does not belong in the chosen base is rejected.

faq.q: How large can the number be?
faq.a: Values are handled as JavaScript BigInt, so they are not limited to 32-bit integers. Very long inputs still work.
